content.text: The key improvement: each workflow branch is now self-contained. `EXISTING_USER` navigates immediately using `pendingEmail`; any other workflow fetches the user's email and handles the null case inline. Adding a new workflow in future just means a new `when` branch — no risk of the two-step conditional getting out of sync.
